headline: Garware Hi-Tech shares double investor wealth over the past year
hook: Garware Hi-Tech doubles in one year
summary: Garware Hi-Tech has delivered 100 percent returns over the past 12 months, turning an initial investment of one lakh rupees into nearly two lakhs. The stock performance highlights strong momentum in the specialty films sector. Retail investors holding the stock benefit from the sharp capital appreciation. Strong past gains draw retail interest, though future returns depend on sustained earnings growth.

headline: Garware Technical Fibres reports 83% profit growth in Q2
summary: Garware Technical Fibres reported an 83% jump in net profit for the second quarter of the current fiscal year. The growth was driven by strong operational performance across its business segments. The company manufactures technical textiles, including fishing nets and geo-synthetics. This result reflects improved margins and demand for its specialized industrial products.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings may boost investor sentiment for the stock
